Question Choices: Sam has 35 baseball cards. He buys 20 more cards and then gives 15 cards to his friend. How many cards does Sam have now?
Solution: First add the purchase: 35+20 = 55 cards. Then subtract the gift: 55-15 = 40 cards remain.

Question Choices: A park has 65 trees on Monday. They plant 25 new trees on Tuesday and trim 20 trees on Wednesday. How many trees does the park have at the end of Wednesday?
Hints: Planting adds trees. Trimming changes the branches but does not remove trees, so only add 65 and 25.
Solution: Planting 25 new trees increases the count: 65+25 = 90. Trimming branches does not remove trees, so the count remains 90.

Question Choices: A kitchen bakes 60 cookies in the morning. They sell 35 cookies before lunch. After lunch, they bake 25 more cookies. How many cookies do they have in total?
Solution: After the sale, 60-35 = 25 cookies remain. Baking 25 more gives 25+25 = 50 cookies.
